# Fun Shapes: Square minus Circle
# Generated from JuliaBUGS.BUGSExamples.VOLUME_3.square_minus_circle
using JuliaBUGS

model_def = JuliaBUGS.@bugs("""
model
{
    x ~ dunif(-1, 1)
    y ~ dunif(-1, 1)
    O <- 1
    O ~ dbern(constraint)
    constraint <- step(x * x + y * y - 1)
}
""", false)

build_model(data) = JuliaBUGS.compile(model_def, data)
